teachingPacket.subject: Device Bridge MCP Ingress Upstream Schema Compliance
teachingPacket.rootCauseAnalysis: Upstream Runtime Fabric validator expects source.devices to be an Array of unique canonical string IDs (nameOk). When object arrays [{id: ...}] or duplicates are returned, validation fails.
correctiveProcedure: 2. Verify source.devices satisfies Array.isArray, length <= 32, every nameOk, and new Set size matches array length
3. Partition detailed telemetry into deviceDetails rather than contaminating the primary devices array
4. Wrap physical read responses with valid result and receipt blocks
5. Execute regression test against live MCP endpoint
